outcome: Culture-negative, respiratory, urinary tract, and resistant infections
cohort: 105 neonates exposed to at least 24 hours of cefepime or ceftazidime between June 1, 2018, and June 1, 2021.
finding: There was no difference in the incidence of culture-positive, late-onset sepsis between neonates who received cefepime compared to ceftazidime.
